interventions.detail: Replaced stale diffusers@t2iadapterxl branch (ImportError hf_cache_home with modern huggingface_hub) with released diffusers==0.35.2 plus pinned transformers/accelerate
Installed CPU torch 2.8.0/torchvision 0.23.0 from PyTorch CPU index and constrained it so controlnet_aux doesn't pull CUDA torch
apt-get install libgl1 libglib2.0-0 libxcb1 for opencv imported by controlnet_aux
Removed .to('cuda') and xformers, used bfloat16 instead of float16, 512x512 with 8 steps on CPU
README passes misspelled kwarg varient='fp16' to T2IAdapter.from_pretrained; corrected to variant
